requirement.statement: The investigation CLI SHALL enumerate all indexed semantic evidence through deterministic bounded pages, and SHALL NOT silently truncate the underlying relation at a fixed row count.

case.given: an indexed database contains more than 5,000 semantic claims
case.when: an external analyzer follows evidence-list continuation cursors
case.then: the analyzer SHALL be able to observe every claim exactly once in claim-id order

requirement.statement: The system SHALL produce a complete IT Asset semantic ontology artifact outside this repository, including business concepts, properties, relations, rules, lifecycles, evidence references, domain coverage, provenance, and unresolved gaps.

case.given: the external synthesizer consumes indexed code evidence
case.then: each normative item SHALL use business language, cite evidence ids, and be rejected when it is only a renamed implementation symbol

case.given: the two original IT Asset source databases
case.when: the delivery runner rebuilds investigation facts
case.then: it SHALL operate only on disposable copies and SHALL not write source databases or accepted ontology facts

requirement.statement: The external solution SHALL provide the retained IT Asset semantic subset as an installable Node.js package that depends on the local cozo-lib-bun package through a file: dependency and initializes the business schema through public cozo-om APIs.

suite.name: 可执行 Cozo OM 建模

case.given: an empty in-memory CozoDB and the external ontology package
case.when: the caller installs the IT Asset ontology
case.then: the package SHALL define the evidence-backed types, relations, rules, and lifecycles, and its cross-entity and lifecycle constraints SHALL be executable
the dependency SHALL use a local file: specifier targeting this repository and SHALL NOT use an npm registry version
